summary: Make the existing offline validation runner the single local and CI entry point, include the source-bundle manifest check, and fail explicitly when Node.js is unavailable instead of silently omitting JavaScript checks.
decision_refs: User request on 2026-09-14 to inspect the files and optimize the workflow using the ponytail rules
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested file inspection and workflow optimization under the ponytail skill.
known_limitations: The all, ui, and remote areas require Node.js; Python-only areas remain usable without Node.js.
The validation workflow is offline and does not assess live provider availability or extraction quality.
